# evroc_lb_l4_route (Resource)

Provides an evroc load balancer L4 route resource. An L4 route directs Layer 4 traffic to a backend service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_backend_service_ref` (String) Fully qualified reference to the backend service (e.g., evroc_lb_backend_service.my_svc.fqid).
- `name` (String) Name of the L4 route. Must be unique within the project.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the L4 route is created. Defaults to provider region.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the L4 route was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `route_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the L4 route.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
